title: Gog and Magog: The Battle for the Mountains of Israel
description: A prophecy concerning the mighty prince Gog from the far north, who gathers a vast army from Persia, Cush, Put, Gomer, and Beth-Togarmah to attack restored Israel. The Lord intervenes with earthquakes, plague, torrential rain, fire, and sulfur, causing Gog to fall on the mountains of Israel. For seven months, Israel buries the army in the Valley of Hamon-Gog, and for seven years they burn their weapons as fuel. Finally, God reveals His holiness by gathering Israel back and pouring out His Spirit upon the people.
